SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

Special Branch. Station. File No.................... Date November 21, 1941.

SUBJECT: Hans GUTWIRTH - Argus Detective Agency.

The attached advertisement was inserted by one named Hans GUTWIRTH, German Jewish Refugee, born on February 5, 1901 in Buk, Germany; in possession of a German "J" Passport No. II/1515/39/2.

Mr. Gutwirth arrived in Shanghai on June 27, 1939, aboard the s.s. "Conte Biancamano". He is a chemist by profession, and following his arrival found employment with "Chemico" a chemical firm at 169 Yuen Ming Yuen Road. Due to the decrease in the business of the firm, Mr. Gutwirth lost his position on March 30, 1941; when he became an agent for the "Scandia Trading Co." Not being able to make a living as an agent, Mr. Gutwirth decided to sever his connection with this firm.

Mr. Gutwirth intends to utilize his spare time by running the "Argus" Detective Agency. He has no staff and is the only "detective" connected with this outfit. He seems to be a respectable person and gives as reference the names of several local businessmen who are known by this office to be upright and honest persons. Mr. Gutwirth has a very amateurish conception about the work of a detective and intends to specialise in "shadowing" the wives of jealous husbands, using all sorts of comic opera disguises. He proposes to charge his clients $2.00 plus expenses per hour of observation.

There is nothing to the detriment of Mr. Hans Gutwirth in S.M.Police records.

（批：C (Crs) Information Does not appear to be a very dangerous character so far.）

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE SPECIAL BRANCH NOV 21 1941）

（批：This job should T.N.T. It might draw attention to more cases! the Special Branch）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报告

特别科。警署。档案号.................... 日期 1941年11月21日。

主题：汉斯·古特维尔特（Hans GUTWIRTH）——阿尔戈斯侦探社。

所附广告由一名名为汉斯·古特维尔特（Hans GUTWIRTH）的人刊登，其为德国犹太难民，1901年2月5日出生于德国布克（Buk）；持有德国“J”字护照，号码为 II/1515/39/2。

古特维尔特先生于1939年6月27日乘坐“康蒂·比安卡马诺”号（s.s. "Conte Biancamano"）轮船抵达上海。他是一名职业化学师，抵沪后在圆明园路169号的“Chemico”化学公司受雇。由于该公司业务缩减，古特维尔特先生于1941年3月30日失业；随后他成为“斯堪的纳维亚贸易公司”（Scandia Trading Co.）的代理。因无法靠做代理维持生计，古特维尔特先生决定切断与该公司的联系。

古特维尔特先生打算利用业余时间经营“阿尔戈斯”（Argus）侦探社。他没有雇员，是与该机构有关的唯一一名“侦探”。他似乎是个正派人士，并提供了几位本地商人的名字作为推荐人，本处已知这些人均是正直诚实之人。古特维尔特先生对侦探工作的概念非常业余，打算专门从事“跟踪”嫉妒丈夫的妻子这类业务，并使用各种滑稽歌剧式的伪装。他提议向客户收取每小时观察费2.00元，外加实报实销的费用。

在上海公共租界警务处的记录中，没有任何不利于汉斯·古特维尔特先生的内容。

（批注：C (Crs) 情报。目前看来似乎不是一个非常危险的人物。）

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处 特别科 1941年11月21日）
